title: Jaw Sword
extract:
The Jaw Sword has the unique look of two interlocking pieces that form its signature jaw-like structure.
The Jaw Sword can be sold for  5,000 and the blueprint for  2,500.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Can use the Jaw Sword-exclusive  Blade of Truth mod.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Iron Phoenix and  Rising Steel (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Above average block angle (55°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.40x))

Above average block angle (55°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)

High disposition (●●●●● (1.40x))

See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Jaw Sword's blueprint can be bought from Nightwave Offerings. Note that the offerings are on a 7-day rotation, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Trivia
Previously, the Jaw Sword was the only longsword that dealt  Puncture as its primary physical damage type. Update 13.0 (2014-04-09) changed a majority of its damage to  Slash, in line with other longswords.
